model.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="call-center-api"}[5m]) * on (job, instance) group_left(deployment_environment) max by (job, instance, deployment_environment) (target_info{job="call-center-api", deployment_environment="development"})))

annotations.summary: call-center-api p95 request duration above 1s on development
annotations.description: Fires when call-center-api p95 request duration on development exceeds 1s over 5m, sustained for 10m. Threshold matches the 1s p95 target documented in _docs/persistence.md. Idle development yields NaN/no data, which does not cross the threshold. Sourced from OTel metrics joined to target_info on deployment_environment, the same join as observability/grafana-dashboard.json.
